children: Oil prices are becoming an increasingly important indicator for European Central Bank policymakers in setting interest rates, Bundesbank President Joachim Nagel said on Tuesday, after high energy costs have pushed inflation off target this year.
"It's definitely not the only indicator (we look at) but it's become a more relevant indicator over the last four years, this is for sure," Nagel told a financial event in London.
"It is obvious that we in governing council have to look at it and we have to take it into account when we take our decisions," he said.
